# LogstoneDB Results

## Milestone 0 verification

- Go version: `go1.27.2 darwin/arm64`.
- Q-A1 (`docs/assumptions.md`): Go 1.27.2 implements Darwin `os.File.Sync`
  through `internal/poll.(*FD).Fsync`, which invokes `fcntl` with
  `F_FULLFSYNC`. The implementation falls back to plain `fsync` only when
  `F_FULLFSYNC` returns `ENOTSUP` (for example, on an SMB mount). Therefore,
  on the local macOS filesystem target, `os.File.Sync` uses `F_FULLFSYNC`.

Relevant source from
`/opt/homebrew/Cellar/go/1.27.2/libexec/src/os/file_posix.go`:

```go
if e := f.pfd.Fsync(); e != nil {
	return f.wrapErr("sync", e)
}
```

The Darwin-specific implementation is in
`/opt/homebrew/Cellar/go/1.27.2/libexec/src/internal/poll/fd_fsync_darwin.go`:

```go
// Fsync invokes SYS_FCNTL with SYS_FULLFSYNC because
// on OS X, SYS_FSYNC doesn't fully flush contents to disk.
_, err := unix.Fcntl(fd.Sysfd, syscall.F_FULLFSYNC, 0)

// There are scenarios such as SMB mounts where fcntl will fail
// with ENOTSUP. In those cases fallback to fsync.
if err != nil && errors.Is(err, syscall.ENOTSUP) {
	err = syscall.Fsync(fd.Sysfd)
}
```
